name: qiuqiu-live2d-bundle
description: Rebuildable live2d-display bundle: pixi.js-legacy (WebGL + Canvas 2D fallback) + pixi-live2d-display-advanced (cubism4; parallelMotion/last-frame hold; its built-in lipsync stays disabled - the app drives the mouth through the vendored wLipSync bridge). Output replaces client/assets/live2d/live2d-display-bundle.js.
